senses.gloss: ch. sameto lift up, v. נְסֵי.
to bring, offer. Pesik. B’shall., p. 90ᵇ, sq. אימיה נשא (Ms. O. נַשְׂאָה) his mother was bringing (the bread); v., however, נְסַח.

units: <cite ref="Taanit 24a">Taan. 24ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 85b">B. Mets. 85ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="N01287"><he>נְשַׁב</he></cite>.
